Sec 2.2: 'The achieved bandwidth is 23 GB/s, which matches the achievable bandwidth (23.9 GB/s in our bandwidth test) from host to GPU using PCIe 4.0x8.' A measured 23.9 GB/s host-to-device is above the Gen4 x8 peak (15.75 GB/s), so x8 is physically impossible and '4.0x8' is a typo.
